editorial.blurb: Birdman Ramen crafts house-made noodles and inventive broths with the care of a fine-dining kitchen, wrapped in a playful comic-book narrative that makes every visit feel special.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask your server (the team here is exceptionally attentive) to customize your ramen—add duck to the tonkotsu, request red chili oil on the garlic bok choy, or go for the vegan ramen; the kitchen accommodates dietary needs with real graciousness.
signatureDishes: Gold Ramen with Spicy Chicken Broth
